verdict.rationale: Docs confirm notebooks can be made public and shared via link to anyone with a Google account, with usage analytics for owners, plus export of notes to Google Docs/Sheets and generation of shareable outputs (slide decks, audio/video overviews) for collaborators to view or build on. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of multi-user collaborative editing or real-time co-authoring within a shared notebook, and confirmation of granular permission controls (edit vs view) beyond public link sharing.
